name: Viktor
self_text: Hi! I'm Viktor, a Chilean woman in my early 20s. When I'm not out with my Nikon, I love fermenting my own hot sauce because I enjoy the science of the flavors. I'm looking for a relaxed photo walk at a slow pace. I'm not interested in gear debates, but I would love for someone to teach me post-processing. I'm available on Saturday morning, Sunday morning, or Sunday afternoon. I'd love to explore some quiet city parks together.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into a relaxed photo walk and you have to be the one who teaches me post-processing. It's a deal-breaker unless there are no gear debates or gear talk is fine but not the point. I'd strongly prefer that you are okay with a slow pace or a moderate pace, though it's not a requirement. It would be nice if you are available Saturday morning, Sunday afternoon or Sunday morning, but no big deal.
